text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Mother. Preparations for the
founding
anniversary party are going
well. I'll fulfill my duty
as the organizer
and make it a success.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Given my tendency to worry, I have
studied ways
to correct my cognitive
bias. Now I have to work
on applying it
to my daily life...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hayahide! I've been looking all
over for you!
Can I borrow you for
something real quick?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. So it's a survival horror game
played in
teams of three.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Winning should be easy with you and
Turbo on
the team!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teiooo, Hayahideee! Hurry up! I'm
already in the
Umalator!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(...Hm. This could offer some ideal
training for
curtailing my cognitive
distortions.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Seems I've used up half of my gun's
energy. I
should keep some recharge
items on hand. But
just to be safe,
perhaps I should also...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Nngh, that's no good... I must correct
my
cognitive bias and alleviate this
anxiety.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How come you still have so many items,

Hayahide?! I burned through all of mine
during
that enemy rush!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well then, I'll give you some of my
extras.
We've still got a long way to go
after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This diary belongs to the owner of this
mansion.
The information is rather
private, but... I can give
it a quick
glance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Beckoned by the temperate weather of
early
summer, I took a stroll around the
garden with my
wife, Mary."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Nngh, I have to stop. I let myself get
absorbed
in minor things due to my
worries. I need to make
haste and keep
up with those two.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to open this door, input the
name of
my beloved person." How am I
supposed to know
that?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Turbo, let me tell you about this
diary I
picked u—

text_block_list.name: Boss Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we defeated the boss! That means
we
finished the game!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't let your guard down.
Teio, get
away from that monster.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it got back up! Don't tell me it
has a
second phase!

text_block_list.name: Boss Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAH... Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, so it tried to fool us by
concealing its full
strength. However, I
noticed that it didn't put up
much of a
fight compared to those earlier foes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Too engrossed with the idea of your
grandiose
plan, you lacked the patience
to execute it
properly. That was your
fatal flaw.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have finished my analysis. I will win,
and you will
lose. Now it's time to prove
my hypothesis!

text_block_list.name: Boss Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Teio and Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yay, we did it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
My engines were full throttle, but you
were even
more amazing, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I knew I had an eye for talent! That
cautious
nature of yours is an innate
talent!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, thank you. I learned a few things
myself
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around campus, I spot
Biwa
Hayahide, who looks quite busy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My family's liquor store is hosting a
founding
anniversary party, and my
parents asked me to
organize it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's an important annual event attended
by
family, friends, and those in our
neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's an important annual event attended
by
family, friends, and those in our
neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right! I must make this party
one that
brings smiles to everyone's
faces.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and feel free to attend if you can
spare the
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course. I've already invited
many from
the academy, including
Taishin and Ticket. I
believe you would
enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Everything has been
accounted for. I
ordered catering in
accordance with the number
of guests,
event schedule, and weather.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have also planned out a seating
arrangement
that accounts for age,
gender, and familiarity.
Conversation
should flow naturally that way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's because I want everyone to
enjoy
themselves. Please join us if you
can.
